newsitem.title: USA: Carnival not profitable since ValuJet crash.
newsitem.headline: Carnival not profitable since ValuJet crash.

text.p: Carnival Air Lines, which announced Friday that it will be acquired by Pan American World Airways, said it had not been profitable since the crash of a ValuJet plane in May of 1996.
"We had been profitable until the ValuJet situation," Carnival owner Micky Arison said at a news conference.

The privately held company does not release financial results. But Arison said the company had been consistently profitable until a ValuJet plane plunged into Florida's Everglades near Miami, killing all 110 people on aboard.
Specific terms of the Pan Am acquisition of Carnival were not released.
